about: Settings of the 'everyday mix' run of the Hermes on/off benchmark: four easy kinds and four harder kinds. Nothing here is a result. Same arms, models and prompt as bench_spec.json.
prompt_suffix: Work through it step by step. Then end your reply with one last line in this form: Answer: <the number, or the letter of the option>

phases.title: Learning phase
phases.about: 240 Tasks, 30 of each of eight kinds. Continuum starts with an empty record file and is never told a kind.

phases.title: Test phase
phases.about: 240 other Tasks of the same eight kinds. Continuum keeps the records of the learning phase. This phase carries the headline figures.

C-marked.about: Continuum on, default settings. After every turn the harness marks the answer good or bad with the plugin's own /continuum command, from the answer key. This stands for a user who marks every turn.

tasks_are: checkable Tasks (half are four easy kinds written by `make_everyday_items.py` from a fixed seed, half are four harder kinds from public sets)
answer_key_is: the answer key (from the generating code for the easy kinds, from the public set for the others)
